question: Does swedendedicated.com still operate, and are its VPS prices (EUR 9.99 / 19.99 / 39.99 monthly on the ladder read 2026-10-22) unchanged?
why: swededicated.com failed DNS resolution on a 2026-11-07 probe; every broker read route was refused (the default read, the jina-keyless, browserless, firecrawl and tavily pins, and a raw fetch), and the Wayback Machine and Cloudflare URL Scanner hold no capture of https://swededicated.com/vps/ for 2026-11, so the order page and the cart could not be read
